newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Xilinx Inc falls.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Xilinx Inc falls.

text.p: Xilinx Inc saw its stock price fall in after-hours trading to 49-1/4 from a close of 51-1/4 on the Nasdaq Stock Market after it released its quarterly earnings, dealers said Thursday.
The company, a supplier of field programmable gate arrays and other computer software, reported a profit of $0.38 a share for the fourth quarter against $0.43 for the same period the previous year.
First Call's consensus among industry analysts forecast $0.36 a share for the same period.
One trader said he otherwise did not see much trading during the after-hours session.
Another dealer said Viasoft Inc was trading at 40-3/4, slightly higher than its close of 39-15/16.
Viasoft reported $0.17 a share for its fiscal third quarter against $0.07 for the same quarter a year ago.
The New York Stock Exchange said Thursday that session one had a volume of 3,300 shares, compared to 116,100 the day before.
Session two had 8.2 million shares against 6.0 million on Wednesday.
